extracted.intended_audience: researchers, journalists, and readers interested in retractions and research integrity
extracted.subtask_description: Compile and present a ranked list of the most highly cited retracted scientific papers, including citation counts before and after retraction and bibliographic details for each item. The list is bounded to a specific cut-off date and uses a defined data source for citation counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection window / snapshot date
rubrics_metrics.description: Top 10 most highly cited retractions as of November 12, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list is explicitly time-bounded — counts and ranking reflect the state of citations at the indicated date; any reproduction should state its own snapshot date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: retracted papers only
rubrics_metrics.description: The compilation includes only papers that have been retracted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each entry shows bibliographic details (title, journal, publication date, authors) together with the year of retraction; only works with an issued retraction are eligible for listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ranking metric: total cites (journals indexed by Web of Science)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total cites (journals indexed by Web of Science) is used to rank papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ranking is based on the total number of citations from journals indexed in the WoS Core Collection. Note that this restricts the citation universe to WoS-indexed journals and affects comparability with other citation sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation temporal breakdown: citing articles before vs after retraction
rubrics_metrics.description: The table reports 'Citing Articles before retraction' and 'Citing Articles after retraction' alongside total cites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presenting pre- and post-retraction citation counts highlights ongoing citations after retraction; the article notes that some papers received more citations after retraction, an important phenomenon to flag and discuss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data source and counting method
rubrics_metrics.description: To obtain the number of citations before and after a retraction the authors relied on the 'Citation index' portion of Clarivate Analytics' Web of Science (WoS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The WoS 'Citation index' only adds up citations from journals indexed by the WoS Core Collection; therefore the sum of before/after citation counts can be lower than the total citation count for the article listed by WoS. Any reuse should disclose this limitation and the exact data field used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about discrepancies and column headings
rubrics_metrics.description: Column headings were changed slightly to better reflect the criteria causing the discrepancy in total counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When presenting citation data, explicitly explain methodology choices and any adjustments to labeling; call out possible causes of discrepancies so readers understand limitations of the counts.
